event_data.context:
The current Development System routes routine helpers, substantive workers, reviewers, Advisor, and evaluation judges using provisional GPT-5.6 defaults. Existing evidence is too narrow to compare reasoning levels or the total cost of retries, review, correction, and escalation.

Implementation notes
Build a fixed, resumable benchmark spanning mechanical assistance, implementation and tests, review, diagnosis and correction, architecture and advice, and orchestration. Compare Luna, Terra, Sol, and Astra at supported effort levels. Measure cost per accepted task across the complete workflow, calibrate rubric-specific judges in isolated environments, preserve compatible review state, and integrate supported winners into a versioned routing catalog. Use the approved conservative quality gate and accept up to 25% slower completion only for at least 25% lower subscription consumption.
event_data.summary: Choose models and reasoning levels for each development role using measured quality, subscription consumption, and completion time. The selected policy should reduce routine usage while preserving reliable results and should send unusually difficult work to stronger models.
event_data.title: Reduce AI development cost without sacrificing quality
